title: Back to goal
text: You receive the ball facing your own goal. A defender is tight behind you.
tip: Check over your shoulder before the ball arrives, so you know what's behind you.

options.text: Spin and try to run past
options.why: The defender is right behind you, so turning here usually loses the ball.

options.text: Pass back to your free teammate
options.why: Play the way you're facing. Your teammate can see the whole pitch and switch the attack.
Good for protecting the ball, but waiting lets more defenders arrive.
